Heard on I.A. No.26377/2024, which is third application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for
suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant-Sonu alias Monu, S/o Vindravan Gharu.

This appeal is filed being aggrieved of judgment dated 08/02/2017 passed in Sessions Trial No.90/2015 by the learned 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Mandla whereby appellant has been convicted in the following manners:-
 Conviction Sentenc  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fine  
 R.I. for 20   376-D I.P.C. Rs.20,000/
 years   R.I. for six   342 I.P.C. Rs.500/-
 months   
 R.I. for one  506-B IPC Rs.1,000/-
 years  5(Chha)/6 POCSO Act Nil Nil
It is submitted that appellant is innocent and he has been falsely 2 CRA-2318-2017 implicated in the matter.
It is also submitted that prosecution has failed to prove the allegation levelled against the appellant.
There are good chances to success in the appeal.

The appellant is in custody, therefore,

1 prays for suspension of sentence of appellant and grant him bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned Public Prosecution opposes the aforesaid prayer.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, it is evident that Dr.Usha Dhurve (PW-7) has clearly opined that hymen of the girl was ruptured.
It has also come on record in the form of ossification test report that age of the prosecutrix was between 14 to 15 years.
The appellant could not point out as to why prosecutrix will falsely implicate him.
When all these facts are taken into consideration, then we are of the opinion that it is not a fit case to extend benefit of suspension of sentence to the appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No.26377/2024 fails and the same is hereby dismissed.
